name: get_biome
title: world.get_biome
lead: Returns the biome name of the column at `pos`; `nil` where that chunk is not in memory.

usedIn.quote: world.get_biome(pos)                      -- the biome name of a column, or nil (chunk not loaded)
world.get_biome(pos)                                -- the same for a loaded chunk; nil when it is not loaded
